title: Signal: Variable format string (cpp) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on variable format strings in cpp code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches a variable-only call to the named formatter; fixed formats with variable arguments never match, and identifiers that merely end in the formatter name (for example sprintf wrappers around printf) are outside this rule.
fpNotes: Wrapper functions forwarding a trusted format are the common false positive — confirm the source.
